profile.name: 管式炉
profile.description: 管式炉是一种用于对管内样品或气氛进行受控加热的高温实验设备，常用于材料退火、烧结、热处理以及高温反应实验。该设备可设定目标温度并读取当前炉温。
profile.description_en: A tube furnace is a high-temperature laboratory instrument used to heat samples or process atmospheres inside a tube under controlled conditions. It is commonly used for annealing, sintering, heat treatment, and high-temperature reaction experiments. The device supports setting a target temperature and reading the current furnace temperature.
